summary: 40 mm drivers and a wide padded headband.
headline: Game-tuned sound. Wired or tri-mode wireless.
description: 40 mm drivers, a wide padded headband and soft over-ear cushions. Choose a wired BL02 or a separate tri-mode wireless model.

features.title: 40 mm drivers
features.text: Game-tuned audio in a proprietary over-ear design.

features.title: Wide padded headband
features.text: A broad headband and soft ear cushions help keep the headset comfortable during play.

features.title: Dual-mic ENC over USB
features.text: The USB-A wired model uses two microphones to reduce background noise in team chat.

variants.name: USB-A wired
variants.description: Digital audio with dual-mic ENC and Windows audio control.

specs.label: Audio control software
specs.value: Windows only. Four presets, custom EQ and adjustable sidetone.

variants.name: 3.5 mm wired
variants.description: Analog audio for devices with a compatible headset jack. Plug into BL10 for desktop Game/Chat control on Windows.

variants.name: Tri-mode wireless
variants.description: Play over 2.4 GHz wireless, Bluetooth 5.3 or a 3.5 mm connection. Switch between Game and Music EQ on the headset.

specs.label: Microphones
specs.value: Detachable boom and built-in microphone options

specs.label: Rated playtime at 50% volume
specs.value: Approx. 60 h with RGB off or 38 h with RGB on. Actual playtime varies.

imageAlt: BL02 over-ear gaming headset with boom microphone
